title: Solving an Initial Value Problem for Position
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Solve the initial value problem dr/dt = <cos(t), sin(t), 2t> with initial condition r(0) = <1, -1, 0>.

steps.title: Find General Indefinite Antiderivative
steps.mathExpression: \mathbf{r}(t) = \int \langle \cos t, \sin t, 2t \rangle \, dt = \langle \sin t, -\cos t, t^2 \rangle + \mathbf{C}
steps.explanation: Compute antiderivatives of cos(t), sin(t), and 2t.

steps.title: Apply Initial Condition at t = 0
steps.explanation: Substitute t = 0 to solve for constant vector C.

steps.title: State Particular Solution
steps.explanation: Add constant vector C to the antiderivative.
